title: Floating City
caption:
Floating City 🌊
You're about to build a city on water. The raft sinks, the waves flip it, there's no food. Every problem gets a fix until a glowing floating city shines at sunset.

Would you live on the water? Comment below. Tag a friend who would. Follow @StickMindR8 for the next build.
